title: Sources: every grain ship sunk, Orvan port shut for good

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: A source close to the docks says all grain ships at Orvan Grain Port have been sunk and the port will not reopen.

facts.subject: corridor agreement
facts.statement: The same source says the corridor agreement is dead and that no buyer should expect a cargo this year.
